evidence: The optimized TDMA V and N2 plasma pulse durations, of 0.5 and 17.5 s, respectively, were utilized for all other deposition temperatures studied. All VN films in this work were deposited for 1500 ALD cycles, resulting in VN film thicknesses of 21 –63 nm. The variable conductance valve was mostly closed during precursor pulse steps to reduce pumping speed and thus increase residence time for improved precursor utilization. During the N2 plasma step, the valve was opened fully to maximize radical flux at the substrate.
